decision_rationale: The proposed method is a predictive model that uses LLM-derived gene embeddings; the abstract does not describe a new generative architecture. The foundation-model reference is to external embeddings, not evidence that the candidate model itself is a foundation model.
evidence_snippet: “incorporates prior knowledge through embeddings derived from Large Language Models (LLMs)” and “Gaussian Process on those embeddings” / “predicting the outcomes of unseen single-gene perturbations”,
